_comment: Golden set. `pairs` are (from → into) verdict expectations checked in the submitted report (project cases) or in the prose (question cases, via `mustMention` / `mustNotSay`). Expected verdicts come from scripts/data/rulings.json, which were verified against the cited authority pages.
